schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_action ON Communication(comm_action)
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_channelid ON Communication(comm_channelid)
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payload ON Communication(payload)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT TOP ({row_count}) 'Action_' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID()) % 100), REPLICATE('X', 100) FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b

tables.name: Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table for reproducing the insert performance issue.
tables.distribution_notes: The table should have 8 million rows with a distribution of comm_channelid values that creates potential for lock contention.
